cases.title: Institutional performance management
cases.challenge: Make departmental performance more visible and actionable.
cases.actions: Developed indicators, monitored approximately 126 centre reports, and converted results into dashboards and performance presentations.
cases.value: Supported reviews, improvement planning, and more informed decisions.

cases.title: Paper-to-digital transformation
cases.challenge: Reduce dependence on paper in committee and field operations.
cases.actions: Advanced a digital operating approach linking documentation, transactions, and follow-up across field and office work.
cases.value: Clearer records and more consistent coordination.

cases.title: Administrative workflow redesign
cases.challenge: Simplify administrative referrals and field recording.
cases.actions: Moved paper transactions into electronic workflows, developed an application for direct field-case recording, and redesigned the referral path.
cases.value: A more direct, organised way to capture and route work.

cases.title: Knights of Excellence
cases.challenge: Encourage consistent excellence practices across departments.
cases.role: Initiative development during the institutional excellence assignment.
cases.actions: Developed assessment and selection criteria and supported workshops.
cases.value: A structured mechanism for recognising improvement practices.

cases.title: Professional capability development
cases.challenge: Expand access to relevant learning opportunities.
cases.role: Contributed to training planning and partnerships.
cases.actions: Helped extend training from approximately five annual courses to year-round opportunities and contributed to a computer fundamentals programme for 104 employees.
cases.value: Broader access to professional and digital skills.
